## First h300 pair from the common-Pyomo scaling campaign

The two returned h300 W STO pilots use Gurobi 13.0.3 and HiGHS 1.15.1 through
Pyomo/APPSI. Both original incumbents passed independent primal and cost
validation and the prescribed 1% relative-gap criterion. They share the
same frozen workbook, ordered warehouse selection, selected directed graph,
scenario probabilities, mathematical contract, bounded-slack policy and
ordered Pyomo algebra. The hardware-class fingerprints and requested resource
profiles also agree. This establishes a matched input and formulation basis;
it does not require identical native presolve or search trajectories.

| Experimental control | Gurobi | HiGHS |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Interface | Pyomo/APPSI | Pyomo/APPSI |
| Native time allowance, s | 28,800 | 28,800 |
| Relative-gap target | 0.01 | 0.01 |
| Solver threads | 1 | 1 |
| Seed | Seed=42 | random_seed=42 |
| Numerical controls | FeasibilityTol=IntFeasTol=1e-9 | mip_feasibility_tolerance=1e-9 |
| Search control | Automatic methods/presolve/cuts; Heuristics=0.05 | parallel=on |

: Settings of the first matched h300 pair. With one permitted thread, enabling
HiGHS parallel search does not establish multiworker parallel execution.
{#tbl-scaling-h300-settings}

: Application effort and observed memory scope for the same pair.
{#tbl-scaling-h300-resources}

The lower bounds are 9.288727295144 and 9.288719505216 trillion BRL for
Gurobi and HiGHS, respectively. Their objective-bound intervals overlap.
Gurobi returned a smaller incumbent and a tighter attained gap in this pair.
Both gaps are substantially below the common 1% stopping target, but neither
is an exact-zero certificate. The observed native-time ratio, HiGHS/Gurobi,
is 8.32. This is a descriptive ratio for two retained outcomes, not a causal
speedup or an estimate of runtime variability from repetitions.

The shared ordered algebra has 25,107,544 variables, including 392 binaries,
1,056,962 linear constraints and 94,967,766 nonzeros. Each solver processed
one node; Gurobi and HiGHS report 3,355,126 and 3,998,477 LP iterations.
Construction, solver transfer, matrix identification and extraction add effort
outside native optimization. Some clocks enclose others and must not be added
as disjoint components. Sampled process-tree memory, Slurm MaxRSS and the
192 GiB requested allowance retain their separate meanings; the observations
do not certify production isolation or an unobserved instantaneous peak.

{#tbl-scaling-h300-physical}

HiGHS has a slightly lower financial subtotal while Gurobi has the lower
penalized total. The financial subtotal alone therefore does not order these
solutions under the modeled objective. Likewise, near agreement in aggregate
service and costs does not imply identical investments or flows. Appendix E
retains their separate first-stage lists and directed flow-distance companions.
Stock exposure and reception overflow have different dimensions and are
not added as installed emergency capacity.

The [source-bound paired audit](https://github.com/unb-lamfo-or-ai-hpc/model-agrologistic/blob/083ef96cc99a346204df22551ce0739c10e8a2f7/docs/evidence/paired_h300_first_pair_20261101.json)
retains original archive identities, matching input/algebra records, effective
parameters, bounds and measurement scopes. Neither observation is an additional
repetition of the historical native-Gurobi h300 sequence. Later thread levels
and repeated measurements remain part of the ongoing campaign, not results
already supplied by this first pair.
